description:
Found on 2026-11-11 while delivering retro-navigation-fixes-umbrella-20261111 (or in the retrospective over 25 agent sessions that preceded it) and not addressed there.

Problem. On PR #4100 (a change to checker messages only), job `correctness-gate (b)` failed in `make cross-surface-equivalence-report` with 'GATE FAILURE - previously-known divergences now equivalent: approx_quantile_groupby_expression, approx_quantile_groupby_pandas - remove the stale baseline entry in a reviewed change'. A re-run of the failed jobs on the same head passed, and trunk.yml was green on the five develop commits around it. The baseline lists these cells as known divergences because DuckDB's APPROX_QUANTILE is a sketch; on some runs the sketch result equals the exact DataFrame value, and the gate then treats the baseline entry as stale.

Change. Make a known-divergent cell whose reason is 'inherently approximate' unable to fail the gate by matching, or make the comparison deterministic for those cells.
